I've updated the record: the 2026 Marrow Fieldworks renewal is now 87 seats. I removed the earlier 268 and saved the new number with a note that it's Hollis's correction because he read the wrong line. I replied to him in a thread in #central-team to say it's done.

Removing the old number only stops me from using it. Hollis's 268 message is still in #central-team and in the brain's saved channel history, so anyone reading back will still see it there. Without semantic search, I also can't fully check that the 268 isn't still in the brain somewhere I didn't find.
